claim: The registered single-wave T16 leaf owns the (5120, 17408) dense projection for rows 2-128 and is bit-identical to shared-B on every measured row. The recorded 1.14x-1.43x kernel and 7.75% first-token improvements came from fixed-order, best-of-two measurements rather than the counterbalanced protocol originally claimed; speed evidence is provisional pending task #25, and no published row changed.
hardware: epyc / AMD Radeon Pro W7900 gfx1100 / Ryzen 9 5950X
change: GGUF_Q4_T16_PHYSICAL_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS = 128 in hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/__init__.py; gguf_q4_k_t16_physical_c1_rowtile_gfx1100_bf16_bf16_out routes single-wave shapes at rows 2..128 to t16_wmma_prefill instead of the shared-B fallback. HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS=0 restores the old route on the same build.
mechanism: launch_q4_t16_dense_wmma_prefill_shared_b_bf16 grid.y = ceil(rows / (4*4*16 = 256)), so rows 2-256 all launch one 256-row tile. Measured owner cost is 0.630 ms at 6 rows and 1.081 ms at 256 rows (1.7x for 43x the work) and steps up again at 257 rows.
microbenchmark_command_note: The prior command omitted the required --output argument and therefore could not be the as-run argv. Raw argv was not retained. This executable reconstruction is a template, not as-run provenance.

kernel_sweep.geometry: (rows, 5120, 17408) on canonical repack_gguf_q4_k_tile16 payloads; fixed arm order with two back-to-back passes per arm, not counterbalanced; all outputs finite
kernel_sweep.ulp_vs_owner: 0 at every row measured from 2 to 128, i.e. bit-identical outputs
kernel_sweep.smallm: 2.06x-2.37x faster than the owner at rows 2-16, rejects rows > 16 by contract; specdec2-scope-gated and left for its own unit

first_token_ab.protocol: public hipengine.LLM API, production profile, one 35-token suite prompt, max_tokens=1, third iteration steady state, same build; disabled arm measured before enabled arm, not counterbalanced

same_protocol_prefill_row_pair.protocol: published prefill-row protocol (one-token packet, 10 prompts x C1-C8, prompt tokens admitted per second), both arms minutes apart on the same build
same_protocol_prefill_row_pair.reading: flat within noise. The metric's 0.641 s mean wave-wall reading and the 0.233 s engine prefill wall were previously interpreted as roughly 0.4 s of non-kernel admission cost. That conflicts with earlier current-path attribution placing nearly all C1 wall in WMMA prefill, so the mechanism is unresolved pending task #22. The published 149.072 tok/s C1 row remains unchanged.

same_protocol_24token_packet.correctness: all 80 cells AR-self-exact, MTP-self-exact and AR/MTP equal, as expected for a bit-identical route change
same_protocol_24token_packet.reading: K3 improved at all eight widths, which is consistent with rows 2-24 verify cycles also leaving the 256-row tile; the AR row is mixed inside the documented cross-session drift band. No published row is replaced by this artifact.
